verdict.rationale: Channel3 is an agent-facing commerce and product-data API that accepts agent payments via MPP, so per-agent spend controls are a fair question for it. The evidence never documents per-agent spend caps, usage limits, or instant revocation of an agent's payment authority. MPP payment support and per-credit billing are adjacent features, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set per-agent spend caps and usage limits and revoke an agent's payment authority instantly
